page.layout: One page of text, single column. Page number (112) at the head. Three numbered paragraphs at the top, then a gap, then an indented errata-style line ("P.53. lin.28.") followed by a paragraph. Below a rule, the closing word FINIS.

main_text.p: 1. Institutiones Grammaticæ Coptæ, Elsu-menadi, & Aben Kateb Keisar.
2. Thesaurus ille supra dictus, seu Nomenclator Ægyptiaco-Arabico-Latinus, quem sca-lam magnam vocant.
3. Prodromi & Lexici supplementum, in quibus multæ de Lingua hac antiquissima scitu digna inveniuntur.
P.53. lin.28. addantur hæc verba, Scripsit etiam Dilherus Grammaticam Syriacam in duodecimo, non indignam quam consulant studiosi; unà cum Eclogis quibusdam, sive Exercitationibus in illam linguam.

page.notes: The first line reads "Elfu-" in print; the long s is read as s, so "Elsu-menadi" is given. Printed "quem fca-lam" is read as "sca-lam". The rule below the text and the blank space are not transcribed. No running head, catchword or signature is printed.
